title: Ghosted trees in the Confidence view fade by dither
items: In the Confidence view, a grade set to Ghost now fades the trees with a fine screen-door pattern at its opacity, as fences and yards already do, instead of drawing the wood a second time. X-ray's trees fade the same way.
That keeps a ghosted view within the frame budget now that the fort's and Dr. Harmon's young fruit trees stand among the woods. The town at Normal is unchanged.
